clusters.headline: Former Coach Darren Lehmann Responds To Khawaja Ball Tampering Claim
aiSummaryBullets: Usman Khawaja alleges that the Australian cricket team was aware of the 2018 ball-tampering plot during the South Africa tour.
Darren Lehmann denies Khawaja’s specific claim about the team's knowledge of the sandpaper incident.

clusters.headline: Kiwi Ferns Advance To Women's Rugby League World Cup Final Stage
aiSummaryBullets: New Zealand secured a spot in the Women's Rugby League World Cup final.
Stacey Waaka achieved a hat-trick of tries during the semi-final match.

clusters.headline: Kalyn Ponga Guides New Zealand To Rugby League World Cup Final
aiSummaryBullets: Kalyn Ponga made an immediate return to professional rugby league after being sidelined for 23 days with a fractured arm.
The New Zealand squad secured a spot in the Rugby League World Cup final following a victory in their recent semifinal match.

clusters.headline: Ben Roberts-Smith Engages In Partnership With Supplements Business
aiSummaryBullets: Ben Roberts-Smith has entered into a professional partnership with the fitness brand Zero Limits.
The supplements company is managed by fitness influencer and podcaster Chris Katelaris.

clusters.headline: Comedian Russell Brand Convicted Of Rape And Sexual Assault Charges
aiSummaryBullets: Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault charges.
The verdict follows legal proceedings brought against the media personality.

clusters.headline: European Passenger Flights Face Third Consecutive Bomb Threat Wave
aiSummaryBullets: A total of 27 passenger flights across Europe have been targeted by bomb threats.
The incidents have been classified by authorities as hoax threats.
